title: PR features
description: What the pr-miner publishes on the pr-features topic (riffle-<environment>-pr-features in GCP) and the scorer consumes: one pull request as the repo miner describes it, so the model sees the same shape it was trained on (ADR 0027). row is a row of mined_dataset.schema.json, made by the miner's own code; while the PR is open its outcome and label fields are null. The ordering key is <tenant_id>/<repo>#<pr_number>.
x-riffle-code-checks: row.repo, row.pr_number and row.head_sha equal repo, pr_number and head_sha
row holds every column the model reads (the miner columns listed in pipelines/training/outcome_features.py MINER_FEATURES)
miner_version is the version the model in service was trained with (part of model_version)

delivery_id.description: The PrEvent's delivery_id; scoring stays idempotent on it

head_sha.description: Head commit of the PR when the event happened

action.description: What triggered the event. Covers every trigger rescore.on can enable; ci_completed is mapped from a completed check suite

miner_version.description: pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/version.py of the miner that made the row

mined_at.description: When the row was made, RFC 3339 in UTC

disabled_sources.description: Miner sources left off for live scoring, so their columns are null: the LLM is never on the scoring path; Semgrep and OSV are slow and mostly empty in training

row.description: One row of contracts/mined_dataset.schema.json for this PR as it stands at head_sha. Outcome and label fields are null while the PR is open; the scorer adds the repo's earlier rows from the history store before scoring
